    jupiter.pos = jupiter.pos + jupiter.velocity
    print(cnt)
    if cnt< 7350/(5*(5**0.5)*((5**0.5)-1)):

from vpython import *
#https://youtu.be/9otQdQ9zD-A?si=Ld5cUHNlWpihP5wi
sun=sphere(pos=vector(-200,0,0), radius=100, texture = "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/99/Map_of_the_full_sun.jpg")
earth=sphere(pos=vector(-400,0,0), radius=20, make_trail=True, texture="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/05/Land_ocean_ice_cloud_1024.jpg")
jupiter=sphere(pos=vector(-1200,0,0), radius=50, make_trail=True, texture="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/76/PIA02863_-_Jupiter_surface_motion_animation.gif")#positions of planets and sun
sat=box(pos=vector(earth.pos.x, earth.pos.y, earth.pos.z), height=21, width=21, length=21)#position of the satellite

dist=((earth.pos.x-sun.pos.x)**2 + earth.pos.y**2 + earth.pos.z**2)**0.5#distance between the sun and the earth

sunmass=5
emass=0.5
jmass=1
stmass=0.01 #mass

RadicalVector = (earth.pos- sun.pos)/dist #unit vector between the sun and the earth
sat.velocity=5*(-RadicalVector)#initial velocity of the satellite

earth.velocity=vector(0,0,5)
jupiter.velocity=vector(0,0,5**0.5)#initial velocity of the planets
ang=gcurve(color=color.blue)#for plotting velocity of the satellite

cnt=0 #count

while True:
    rate(100)
    cnt +=1
    earth.pos = earth.pos +earth.velocity 
    dist=((earth.pos.x-sun.pos.x)**2 + earth.pos.y**2 + earth.pos.z**2)**0.5 #distance between the sun and the earth
    RadicalVector = (earth.pos- sun.pos)/dist #unit vector between the sun and the earth
    Fgrav=-10000*RadicalVector/dist**2#force between the sun and the earth
    earth.velocity = earth.velocity + Fgrav
    earth.pos = earth.pos + earth.velocity
    jupiter.pos = jupiter.pos +jupiter.velocity
    jdist=((jupiter.pos.x-sun.pos.x)**2 +jupiter.pos.y**2 + jupiter.pos.z**2)**0.5#distance between jupiter and the sun
    jRadicalVector = (jupiter.pos- sun.pos)/jdist #unit vector between the jupiter and the sun
    Fgravj=-10000*jRadicalVector/jdist**2#force between the sun and the jupiter
    jupiter.velocity = jupiter.velocity + Fgravj
    jupiter.pos = jupiter.pos + jupiter.velocity
    print(cnt)
    if cnt< 7350/(5*(5**0.5)*((5**0.5)-1)):
        sat.pos= earth.pos
    else: 
        satdist=((sat.pos.x-jupiter.pos.x)**2 + (sat.pos.y-jupiter.pos.y)**2 + (sat.pos.z-jupiter.pos.z)**2)**0.5#distance between the earth and the satellite
        sRadicalVector=(sat.pos-jupiter.pos)/satdist#unit vector between the earth and the satellite
        sFgrav=-15000*sRadicalVector/satdist**2#force between the earth and the satellite
        sat.velocity = sat.velocity + sFgrav
        sat.pos = sat.pos + sat.velocity
        print((sat.velocity.x**2 + sat.velocity.y**2 + sat.velocity.z**2)**0.5)
        ang.plot(cnt-542,(sat.velocity.x**2 + sat.velocity.y**2 + sat.velocity.z**2)**0.5)#graph
        if cnt%10==0:
            sat.clone()
